decision.reason: USITC on 9 October 2026 instituted Section 337 investigation 337-TA-1526 on Vicor allegations covering vertical power delivery in AI server components; 20 named respondents incl. Foxconn, Luxshare, Quanta. Institution is NOT a ruling of infringement, and no import ban exists yet. For suppliers and compliance counsel, BOM/supplier/affected product and patent claim-to-technical review evidence chain is a manual legal-technical readiness job, not automatic infringement opinion.
